g: Take Oort-NX-0.5.0-beta.3.dmg from the release page. You need an Apple silicon Mac and macOS 26 or later.
Open the DMG and drop Oort NX on Applications.
The DMG window, captured on an earlier trial
Apple has not notarised the app: the first opening is refused. Go to System Settings › Privacy & Security, then Open Anyway (Apple explains). Do not turn off macOS protections.
The welcome tour starts. You can skip it.
Your library is copied and every file checked; the old one stays intact. Sign in to your services once, and do not open both versions together.
The tour says whether it is recognised. Otherwise, go on with keyboard or mouse.
Oort lists the game apps it finds and the files of a folder you choose. Adding moves nothing and builds nothing.
Google Drive, Nextendo, Steam and save copies are optional. Later leaves them off.
Settings › General › Welcome setup. Nothing is reset.
Add a Switch game to build
Your own game files, your prod.keys, and the right to use them. Oort provides no game, key or firmware. Building also needs Xcode 27.2 or later, the expected Metal compiler and macOS 26.6.
The build tools; the keys shown are an invented, refused file (picture in French)
Settings › Switch › Engine › Open Setup shows what is missing. Each installation asks first and shows where it goes.
Add game, or ⌘N, then your NSP, XCI, NSZ, XCZ or NUP files. They stay where they are.
The Library menu of the control center
Look at the game, update, DLC, destination and space. Add to library only keeps the game for later.
The Review step with an invented game.
Add and port starts the engine; you can close the screen, it goes on. How long depends on the game and the Mac. No real game was built with this version.
An invented game, Build button (picture in French)
Settings › Switch › Game folders, Game apps row. Changing folder moves no app.
Scan game apps › Scan. A game already built starts without Xcode or its original files.
Add game › Add ported app copies the app and checks its signature. Only add what comes from a source you trust.
The app added, content not verified (picture in French)
Settings › Integrations › Steam. Oort reads the list of installed games and writes nothing in Steam.
Refresh Steam reads the list again. Only installed Mac games show.
Play goes through Steam, which opens the game. Checked with a fake Steam.
Settings › Integrations › Mac apps › Add an app…, or drop an .app on the library.
It opens the app, without changing it and without counting time. If it moves, use Locate the app….
An invented Mac app in the library, options open.
Choose a game, then Play. The button always says the next step: Play, Build, Download.
An invented game, Play button (picture in French)
Quit the game: Oort comes back in front, unless you moved to another app. On a recently built game, Home also offers to come back without closing it.
The session card, with an invented game.
The Players screen places up to eight players. The game follows it only if its build supports it.

Reminders are at the bottom of the screen. The keyboard reminders, at the bottom of the screen
This table is the Oort layout. An earlier profile keeps Arcane, where settings are on held Menu: Settings › Controllers › Controller layout.
If macOS keeps it, Oort says so once. Home Button Overrides opens the macOS setting.
In Settings › Controllers, it is drawn in dots and lights what you press. Not tried with a real controller in this version.
Search at the top of the list. Changed settings shows what you changed.
Settings › Appearance: theme, background and interface size, from 80 to 125%.
Settings › Sound: volume, sound pack, and your own notes with Compose.
Settings › Home chooses the cards and tabs.
Oort asks before leaving if a setting is not saved.
Keeping your built games online and finding them on another Mac. Only Google Drive is supported, and your saves are not in it. Keep a copy of what matters.
Oort uses the rclone already on your Mac, or asks before taking rclone.org’s. Advanced lets you choose yours.
Keep an existing connection, or Sign in. Google gives rclone access to your whole Drive, not to one folder.
Oort looks for a library in Games, otherwise you give a path. This choice moves nothing.
The Cloud tab shows what is online. Download app brings it back; Download game files then asks you to build.
The Cloud tab with an invented game (picture in French)
Disconnect removes the connection from this Mac. Files stay in your Drive. Other tools may use that rclone connection.
Game closed: Game options › Saves › Back up now. It is dated and verified.
The Saves panel with an invented game.
Import save…, choose the copy, read the preview, confirm. Oort first copies the current save.
Settings › Saves: off, iCloud Drive or a folder of yours. Turn it off to import or restore. Syncing does not replace a copy.
Oort does not touch their saves.
Settings › About › Check now. Oort also looks by itself, once a day at most.
Settings › About, in a trial copy
Update downloads, checks, replaces and reopens Oort. It waits for a build or a game to end.
The update window with an invented version.
It cannot move to this version by itself: install the DMG once.
The DMG window, captured on an earlier trial
Move Oort NX to the Trash. Your built games, files and saves stay.
Oort NX dragged to the Trash.
Erase its library if you like
It is in ~/Library/Application Support/Oort NX. Careful: your save backups and the copy of your keys are there too.
A built game is a Mac app: it opens without Oort. Its saves are in ~/Library/Application Support/nxnative.
Settings › Integrations: check the Steam folder, then Refresh Steam. The game must be installed and made for Mac.
Settings › Switch › Engine says what is wrong. A game already built still starts.
To rebuild: Game options › Edit details › Attach sources…. To play, the app is enough.
An invented game, Build button (picture in French)
Settings › Cloud library, then test the connection. Oort keeps the last known state and says so.
Open a report: what you were doing, what you saw, your versions. Read Copy diagnostics before pasting it. Attach no game, key or save.
What Oort reads, writes and sends
The folders you choose. If you turn it on, Steam’s game lists. If you build, your files and your keys, on this Mac.
~/Library/Application Support/Oort NX, the apps it builds, and the settings and mods of built games. Nothing in Steam. Only you can read the copy of your keys.
It asks GitHub whether a newer version exists. It looks for pictures, scores and descriptions with your games’ name or number: Nlib, GameTDB, Steam, Wikidata, Wikipedia and other public sources.
Google Drive, Nextendo, GameBanana mods, SteamGridDB, IGDB: only once turned on, with your own account where one is needed. Building sends no game file and no key.
On the release page, choose the x64-setup.exe installer for Windows 10 or 11 x64, or arm64-setup.exe for Windows 11 on ARM. Also get SHA256SUMS. Windows 10 was not tried.
The release page on GitHub, files unfolded.
In PowerShell, type Get-FileHash followed by the name of the installer you chose. The result must match its line in SHA256SUMS.
The terminal with the checksum and its answer.
The installer is not signed: Windows shows “Windows protected your PC”. Choose More info, then Run anyway, only for this checked file.
The SmartScreen window, before and after “More info”.
It installs for your account, without administrator rights. If WebView2 is missing, the installer takes Microsoft’s; that case was not tried.
The installer windows, one by one.
It is in the Start menu. The guided setup opens; you can skip it.
